text:
ryan: Heads-up — Sailfish wants a model bakeoff next week between sf-3b-quant and their sf-7b-int8 fine-tuned variant. They need: POC pricing, KMS requirements, EU data residency (eu-west-1), and a short onboarding checklist. Can eng/security confirm hosted vs dedicated support? cc @jia @omar @liz

jia: We can run both, but notes: sf-7b-int8 depends on specific kernels (INT8 path) and has known perf variability for >4k context. KV cache with int8 needs validation; prefix caching sometimes causes output drift. Recommend dedicated or Private for stable latency during bakeoff. Need sample prompts/seq length distribution.

omar: Dedicated supports pinning variants + autoscale, and gives predictable throughput. Hosted can do quick spin-ups but may fallback to 3b if capacity constrained. For eu-west-1 dedicated we need node reservation; I can provision a short-lived pool. 

liz: Security checklist: Hosted cannot accept customer-managed KMS keys. Private can import customer KMS/HSM (with paperwork). We also need Sailfish to sign the SCCs and provide subprocessor questions. I'll start a questionnaire template.

sam: Pricing quick estimates for a 2-week POC (50k tokens/day): hosted (usage) ~= $400–600 pro-rated, Dedicated reserved pool (pro-rated for 2w) ~= $2.5k–4k depending on node size + support. If they want Private + KMS import adds integration fee. We can offer credits for the bakeoff to de-risk.

ryan: I'll share prompt set + sample dataset by EOD. Can someone produce a short compatibility matrix + onboarding steps we can give the customer tomorrow? Need quick bullet list they can hand to infra/ML ops.

jia: I'll make the matrix (CSV) with columns: model, quantization, kv_cache_ok, max_seq, recommended_deploy, known_issues. Quick notes: sf-3b-quant -> good for hosted, cache OK, max_seq 4096. sf-7b-int8 -> best on Dedicated/Private, disable prefix cache for long chat.

omar: I'll spin up a dedicated POC env in eu-west-1 and give an endpoint + temp creds. ETA ~3h. Also add health checks and per-route tracing.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment POC-1745 to eu-west-1 queued (starts in ~10m).

liz: Ryan — for the questionnaire I need their DPA contact and whether they will provide a KMS key or want Redwood-managed keys. Also flag: export control review if model weights come from third-party sources.

sam: For rollout strategy: we can do canary 10% -> 50% in 24h with automatic fallback to sf-3b-quant on error rates >2%. That lowers risk for the POC.

ryan: Perfect — I'll tag legal + sailfish security and drop the prompt set. Thanks all :thumbsup:

---
Notes/inlined-commands shared in thread:
`redwood model onboard --model sf-7b-int8 --quant int8 --region eu-west-1 --deployment dedicated`

Checklist (high-level):
- Provide prompt set + typical seq lengths (ryan)
- Security: DPA + KMS decision (liz)
- Infra: Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 + endpoint (omar)
- ML: compatibility matrix + caveats (jia)
- Sales: POC pricing + credit offer (sam)
- Ops: canary + fallback policy configured

If anyone wants the matrix quick-draft I can paste it here once ready.
